This implies a possible pharmacological pathway where Norgestimate may influence hormonal regulation, potentially through its interaction with the endocrine system, which is central to bone metabolism. The indirect connection between Norgestimate and postmenopausal osteoporosis highlights a possible role in hormonal balance, though the exact mechanism remains unclear. The evidence supports a repurposing scenario, but further studies are needed to confirm the direct therapeutic effect of Norgestimate on bone density in postmenopausal women.
